purpose: Teach: マウンテン/ロハス/ベア/アルト/デュオ/ゴースト/オーソドックス/スピリット

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがマウンテンの写真集を見せて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to show us his mountain photography collection.
lines.style: Warm observation, gentle and pleased. Soft opening. Even pace, like sharing something quiet and tender. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとロハスな菜園を作ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I made this amazing organic vegetable garden together.
lines.style: Bright, genuine excitement. Quick initial attack on the opening. Light, unguarded delivery—the pride of something made with someone he loves. No performing, just real joy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがテディベアを下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad gave you a teddy bear.
lines.style: Tender, almost reverent softness. Slow, gentle pace. She's noticing the significance of the gift, not just reporting it. Slight warmth on the closing word.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんからアルトリコーダーを頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad gave me an alto recorder.
lines.style: Pure, unfiltered delight. Quick bright opening on the first word. Natural rhythm—he's sharing something precious without needing to sell it. Genuine child-warmth throughout.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとお母様が音楽のデュオを組まれたわ
lines.en: Sho, your parents started playing music together as a duo.
lines.style: Reflective, noticing something deeper. Moderate pace, almost wondering. There's quiet warmth here—witnessing something beautiful forming. Slight rise in tone on the closing phrase.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと不思議なゴーストの絵本を読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I read this strange ghost picture book together.
lines.style: Excited but grounded. Opening with natural curiosity about the 'strange' element. Conversational pace, the comfort of sharing something a little spooky with someone safe. Real and unaffected.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがオーソドックスな囲碁を教えて下さってるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been teaching you go—the traditional way.
lines.style: Reflective, appreciative of the tradition being passed down. Measured pace. Soft but present. There's recognition of something old and meaningful in her tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんが「家族のスピリット」って仰ってたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad said something about the family spirit.
lines.style: Soft, impressed clarity on those last few words. Opening is conversational and close. He's quoting something that mattered, trusting her to understand. Slight trailing softness at the end.
